note: 试卷预设：两道 choices（带 group/answer/explanation）+ 一个 submit 聚合交卷。分数与对错在客户端当场算，点“交卷”不产生模型回合。

items.content: 选完点交卷，分数和解析立刻出现——判卷在浏览器里完成，不需要模型参与。

items.prompt: 一段 dsh-ui 围栏最外层必须是什么？
items.explanation: 围栏体是一个至少含 items 数组的规格对象；单个组件根也能被规范成一行规格。

items.label: 一个组件对象
items.hint: 只写 {"type":"table"} 也能渲染，但不是完整规格

items.label: 一个含 items 的规格对象
items.hint: 标题、间距、计算字段都挂在规格根上

items.label: 一段 HTML
items.hint: 白名单渲染，没有任意 HTML 路径

items.prompt: 哪种操作需要模型回合？
items.explanation: 排序、过滤、判卷、折叠都是本地状态；只有需要新内容或执行工具时才回传 action。

items.label: 展开行明细
items.hint: 本地状态，刷新后按内容指纹恢复

items.label: 让模型换一份数据
items.hint: 只有这类请求才需要 action 回传

items.content: Answer both, press submit, and the score plus explanations appear at once — grading happens in the browser, with no model involved.

items.prompt: What must the outermost value of a dsh-ui fence be?
items.explanation: The fence body is a spec object with at least an items array; a bare component root is normalized into a one-item spec.

items.label: A single component object
items.hint: {"type":"table"} renders too, but it is not a full spec

items.label: A spec object containing items
items.hint: Title, gap and computed fields all live on the spec root

items.label: A block of HTML
items.hint: Rendering is whitelisted — there is no arbitrary-HTML path

items.prompt: Which interaction actually needs a model turn?
items.explanation: Sorting, filtering, grading and collapsing are local state; an action only flows back when new content or a tool run is required.

items.label: Clicking a table header to sort
Expanding a row's detail
items.hint: Local state, restored by content fingerprint

items.label: Asking the model for a different dataset
items.hint: Only this kind of request sends an action back
